title: Star-delta fan
summary: Extract fan EF-2: 5.5 kW star-delta starter with timer, interlocks and an overload in the winding circuit.
brief:
**Client:** Riverside bottling plant (fictional).
**Equipment:** extract fan **EF-2**, 5.5 kW, **400 V Δ / 690 V Y**, FLC 10.7 A.

The site electrical engineer will not allow a DOL start on this board because of voltage dip.

**Scope**
- Main **KM1**, star **KM2**, delta **KM3**; star/delta electrically and mechanically interlocked.
- On-delay timer **KT** set so the fan is near full speed at changeover (start at 4 s, adjust on test).
- Overload **F2** in the winding circuit, set to 0.58 × FLC.
- Six-core motor cable (two sets), PE.

**Deliverables:** wired and tested starter, star current and changeover recorded.

ioList.connection: L1 L2 L3 to F2, then U1 V1 W1
L1 to W2, L2 to U2, L3 to V2
Between KM1 and U1 V1 W1
U1 V1 W1 and W2 U2 V2, PE

logic.action: KM1, KT and KM2 in: motor in star
15-16 opens: KM2 out; then 17-18 and KM2 21-22 let KM3 in
Motor in delta at full torque

schedule.step: Isolation, lock off, prove dead at all six motor terminals
Check nameplate is 400 V Δ; remove terminal box links
Mount contactors (KM2/KM3 mechanical interlock), KT, F2
Wire power circuit: main, delta, star point, six motor cores
Wire control circuit, timer and interlocks
Dead tests on both cable sets; record
Set F2 and KT; functional test with clamp meter

testIntro: Run the starter and record each result. Start each row from rest: press STOP and let the fan stop first.

testSheet.text: Press START. Motor current 1 s later (in star)
In star, voltage across one winding U1 to U2
After changeover, voltage across one winding U1 to U2
Running in delta: motor line current

faults.report: The star-point link KM2 4 to KM2 6 is broken: the star is incomplete.
The timer KT has lost its 0 V (A2) wire: it never times out and the fan stays in star.
Main contactor KM1 pole 1-2 is open: no L1 to U1.
The KM3 (delta) coil is open circuit.

faultChecks.fail: Star and delta were in together.
The motor is not in star at start.
The fan is not running after changeover.
The windings are not in delta after changeover.

extraReports: Nothing is wrong: the starter works as specified.
modelAnswer:
**Test sheet:** star current about **21.5 A** at start (2 × FLC in this model: one third of the 6 × FLC a DOL start would draw). Winding voltage in star **231 V**. After changeover KM2 is **out**, the winding voltage is **400 V** and the line current is **10.7 A**. F2 carries 6.2 A, under its 6.2 A setting.

**Fault notes:** a fan that hums at start and then runs after changeover has a star-circuit fault (KM2 or the star point). A fan that starts and then stops at changeover has a delta-circuit fault (KT 17-18, KM2 21-22, KM3 coil). A fan that stays in star and trips after half a minute has a timer fault.
schematicIntro: The working starter. Press START and watch star, the timer and the changeover to delta in the event log and the motor current.
